staticContent.LocalizedString: Isn't that my boss?! Boss, what happened? Is that a call for help?

staticContent.SourceString: 别这么说。迦楼罗的大家本来就是好朋友，我们迦楼罗和海特洛的市民、异象、花花草草今后也要做好朋友啊！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Don't say that! Everyone in Garuda already gets along. From now on, we in Garuda should be friends with Hethereau's citizens, Anomalies, and even its flora!

staticContent.LocalizedString: Was your account hacked?

staticContent.LocalizedString: Lovey-Dovey Garuda? What kinda group is this? Who added me?

staticContent.SourceString: 我刚接报有人闹事 结果一到现场 一群小混混对我笑，，，，，，，
staticContent.LocalizedString: I just got word that someone was causing trouble, but when I got there, a bunch of punks were smiling at me…

staticContent.SourceString: ，，，，太诡异了 这是不是啥新型异象啊 @鉴定师
staticContent.LocalizedString: … That's so weird. Is this some new kind of Anomaly, @Appraiser?

staticContent.SourceString: 看着……不太像？
staticContent.LocalizedString: It… doesn't really look like one?

staticContent.SourceString: 似乎只是比较友好？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Maybe they're just being friendly?

staticContent.SourceString: 鉴定师说的没错哦~大家相亲相爱，我们现在正在比赛，看看哪一个帮派能最先捡光北角镇的垃圾！
staticContent.LocalizedString: You got it right, Appraiser~ Everyone's finally getting along, and we're all having a contest to see which gang can pick up all the trash in Northridge Town first!

staticContent.SourceString: @ヽ莪愛嘚太痛ゝ 赶紧过来，接下来还要维护环境、修理鸟窝，别偷懒！不要丢掉迦楼罗的荣耀！
staticContent.LocalizedString: @xX_LuvHurts_Xx Hurry on over! We still need to take care of the environment and repair some bird nests, so no more slacking! Don't let Garuda's glory fade!

staticContent.SourceString: 刚才路过看到了还以为在拍戏
staticContent.LocalizedString: I was just passing by and saw it. I thought they were filming something.

staticContent.SourceString: 迦楼罗还会修鸟窝？酷！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Garuda repairs bird nests too? How cool!

staticContent.SourceString: 迦楼罗能飞！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Garuda can fly!

staticContent.SourceString: 从这里的海水能看到奇妙的东西浮上来……
staticContent.LocalizedString: You can see amazing things rising up from the sea here…

staticContent.SourceString: 很有氛围感的海边！
staticContent.LocalizedString: What a lovely beachy vibe!

staticContent.SourceString: 是吧我也很喜欢~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Right? I'm really enjoying it too~

staticContent.SourceString: 噢噢！去旅游了吗？这是哪里？感觉会有前所未见的水系獭麻吉+<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>
staticContent.LocalizedString: Ooh! Did you go on a trip? Where is this? I bet there are some never-before-seen Water-type Tamachi here!<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>

staticContent.SourceString: 是就连小灵可也不能透露的、某个超绝密的宝藏观海景点哦！
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's an ultra-secret hidden gem with an amazing sea view—I can't even tell you where it is, Linko!

staticContent.SourceString: ？<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003" width="desired" height="desired"/>
staticContent.LocalizedString: ?<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003" width="desired" height="desired"/>

staticContent.SourceString: 哈哈，不过如果这里真的有前所未见的獭麻吉，我下次去那边的时候会顺手抓一只回来送给你的~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Haha, but if there really is a never-before-seen Tamachi around here, I'd bring one back for you next time I go~

staticContent.SourceString: 期待<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>
staticContent.LocalizedString: Can't wait!<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>

staticContent.SourceString: 还没看腻啊
staticContent.LocalizedString: Still not tired of the view?

staticContent.SourceString: 不会啊，非常好看的海，比你天天在互联网的海洋里盯着翻涌的垃圾要有意思很多哦
staticContent.LocalizedString: Not at all! The sea's gorgeous—way more interesting than scrolling endlessly through the internet's ocean of trash, like you do~

staticContent.SourceString: 是我想盯着吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Do you really think I want to stare at that kinda stuff all day?

staticContent.SourceString: 所以才说，同样是看海，我这边可是一直看下去都不会乏味的~你那边就加油保持耐心吧
staticContent.LocalizedString: Well, that's what I mean—we're both looking at the sea, but I could keep looking at mine forever and never get bored~ You, on the other hand, just keep working on your patience over there.

staticContent.SourceString: <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003" width="desired" height="desired"/>看不懂你们在说什么……又吵架了？
staticContent.LocalizedString: <TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_003" width="desired" height="desired"/>I don't understand what you two are talking about… Are you arguing again?

staticContent.SourceString: 没有哦~小灵可误会啦！这种程度算不上
staticContent.LocalizedString: Nope~ Little Linko, you got the wrong idea! This hardly counts as an argument.

staticContent.SourceString: 确实是一个被打造得很漂亮的地方啊。
staticContent.LocalizedString: It really is a well-designed place.

staticContent.SourceString: 诶嘿~谢谢你的夸奖，鉴定师！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Hehe~ Thanks for the compliment, Appraiser!

staticContent.SourceString: 设想一下你梦到一片气氛是如此这般的地方，面前有着一个这种样子的电话亭……接下来，这个梦会如何进行下去？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Imagine you're dreaming of a place with this kind of atmosphere, with a phone booth just like this right in front of you… What would happen next?

staticContent.SourceString: 1.电话铃是怎么响起来的？
staticContent.LocalizedString: 1. What does the phone's ringing sound like?

staticContent.SourceString: 好吓人啊？我赶紧捏一把脸看看能不能把自己弄醒！
staticContent.LocalizedString: That's pretty scary! I'd pinch myself to see if I could wake up!

staticContent.SourceString: 说不定响起来一听发现，竟然是我闹钟的声音？！哇呀呀！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Maybe it'll start ringing, and then I'll actually realize it's my alarm clock?! Aaah!

staticContent.SourceString: 如果是最近的话，感觉铃声会是在循环的那个专辑。
staticContent.LocalizedString: These days, it'd probably just sound like the album I've had on repeat.

staticContent.SourceString: 不要响 安魂曲 还想睡
staticContent.LocalizedString: Don't ring. Lacrimosa still wants to sleep.

staticContent.SourceString: 2.你要去接那个电话吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: 2. Would you answer the phone?

staticContent.SourceString: 接。如果不立即接，可能会错过紧急派单。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'd answer. If I don't pick up right away, I might miss an urgent dispatch.

staticContent.SourceString: 它不是都已经飘起来了吗？还要怎么接
staticContent.LocalizedString: Isn't it already floating? How am I supposed to answer it?

staticContent.SourceString: 难道还能扭头就跑？
staticContent.LocalizedString: What else am I supposed to do, turn around and run?

staticContent.SourceString: 其实按照恐怖片的套路，就算不去接，这个东西说不定也会自己爬过来……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Actually, by horror-movie logic, even if you don't answer, that thing might crawl over to you by itself…

staticContent.SourceString: 3.这通电话是怎样的内容？
staticContent.LocalizedString: 3. Once answered, what would the call be about?

staticContent.SourceString: 大概能猜到哦<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_005" width="desired" height="desired"/>
staticContent.LocalizedString: I can kind of guess~<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_005" width="desired" height="desired"/>

staticContent.SourceString: 是曳尔沐前辈来找我聊天了吧＞＜？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Maybe Elyms called me to chat? ><

staticContent.SourceString: 来自外星人的宇宙通讯+<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>
staticContent.LocalizedString: Cosmic communication from aliens+<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>

staticContent.SourceString: 从电话亭之前的行动来看，它无论如何都想引起接电话的这个人的注意……所以我猜，电话里会讲一个非常非常想告诉我的故事。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Judging by what the phone booth did earlier, it clearly wanted whoever answered to notice it… So I'm guessing the call contains a story it really, really wants to tell.

staticContent.SourceString: 嗯嗯。原来如此，从细节中能了解到大家各自的思考方式啊~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Mm-hmm, I see. You can tell how everyone thinks just from the little details they include in their answers~

staticContent.SourceString: 唔，感觉虽然确实是有问问题，但好像还是不动声色把梦的走向引导到了去接听那通电话的内容啊……？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Hmm, even though you were asking questions, it feels like you still subtly steered the dream toward answering that phone call…?

staticContent.SourceString: 还有其他路线吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Are there any other options in this scenario?

staticContent.SourceString: 从开头就砸掉
staticContent.LocalizedString: Smash it from the start.

staticContent.SourceString: 比如像这样！选项可能在旁白之外哦~！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Like that, for example! Some choices aren't spelled out in the narration~!

staticContent.LocalizedString: I encountered one yesterday. I had to drive into a small alley to avoid it. I almost got late and lost my 5-star review!

staticContent.LocalizedString: I also came across some biker gangsters a while ago in that area. I hope they just don't come out.

staticContent.SourceString: 哈尼娅你也要多加小心。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Haniel, you take care too.

staticContent.LocalizedString: You bet I'll be careful! Tysm, Hathor sis! (≧▽≦)(≧▽≦)(≧▽≦)

staticContent.LocalizedString: Yes, ma'am.

staticContent.LocalizedString: I should have seen this earlier… some biker gangster just left a long scratch on my new car. Bummer.

staticContent.LocalizedString: My Speedy Torny got scratched too. I also just got it maintained… (╥﹏╥)

staticContent.LocalizedString: The leaves of a new plant are getting a little soggy. What should I do?

staticContent.SourceString: 怎么会这样！我今天明明好好浇过水了！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Wait waaaaat? I litterally just watered it today!

staticContent.SourceString: 怎么可能！我今天明明按时施过肥了！
staticContent.LocalizedString: That's not possible! I just fertilized the plant today!

staticContent.SourceString: 嗯……这两件事，我今早其实也都做了。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Well… I did both of those actions earlier today.

staticContent.SourceString: 还好我只是早上给它松了土、晒了晒太阳。
staticContent.LocalizedString: At least I only shoved the soil a bit and let it have some sunlight.

staticContent.SourceString: 海特洛的夜景总是别有风味。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Hethereau's night views are really something else.

staticContent.SourceString: 感谢九原姐！Firmament顶层餐厅的夜景好漂亮！甜点更是好吃到不行！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Thanks, Jiuyuan sis!! The night view at Firmament's top-floor is stunning and the desserts are unreal!

staticContent.SourceString: 某人对着夜景拍了半个小时，最后一张能用的照片都没挑出来(￣︶￣)
staticContent.LocalizedString: A certain someone spent half an hour taking pictures. In the end, not even one picture was presentable! (￣︶￣)

staticContent.LocalizedString: It's called being immersed! Meanwhile, someone complained about how the dessert was too sweet, but still lowkey snuck back for three more plates! (￣︶￣)

staticContent.LocalizedString: Looking at who commented… just the there of you there? JIuyuan didn't bring Hathor?

staticContent.SourceString: ？我在。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm here?

staticContent.SourceString: 简森哥别数啦！我们出门前可是特意绕路去了白贝壳餐厅，给你定了招牌点心，等你任务结束后回来就能吃！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Jensen, stop counting omg!! We detoured to White Shell before heading out and ordered their signature desserts for you. They'll be ready when you wrap up work!

staticContent.SourceString: 还有你念叨好久的那家限量咖啡豆，九原姐也帮忙订到啦，这趟不亏吧！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Also, Jiuyuan sis manged to order those limited coffee beans you were talking about! Not a bad trip at all!

staticContent.SourceString: 好，我会尽快完成任务回来的。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Alright. I'll be back as soon as possible.

staticContent.LocalizedString: 2-Four really doesn't care about old customers. It wasn't like this when the store just opened… It has changed for the worse…

staticContent.LocalizedString: Instant coffee? Gross! I much prefer Mr. Adler's hand-brewed coffee!

staticContent.SourceString: 还让你挑上了
staticContent.LocalizedString: You're one to be picky.

staticContent.LocalizedString: We have the same coffee at Eibon as the one that was being given out. Maybe we can stock up some more when there's a sale.

staticContent.SourceString: 要钱的就不要了，难喝，等你手泡
staticContent.LocalizedString: I don't want it to cost Fons. It tastes bad anyway. I'll have your artisan coffee instead.

staticContent.SourceString: 明白，小姐。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Understood, Lady.

staticContent.SourceString: 原来你自己也喝过吗？还以为咱们只有对不怎么待见的客人才会拿那个出来凑数呢。
staticContent.LocalizedString: So you tried it before too? I thought we only brought that coffee to customers we don't care for.

staticContent.SourceString: 我这不是体贴客人、观察得细致入微吗？喝了的脸色都不太好，那想必味道不怎么样咯
staticContent.LocalizedString: What can I say, I'm just thoughtful and observant. Everyone who tried it made a strange face, so I'm guessing it doesn't taste great.

staticContent.SourceString: 某些刁钻的客人哪，协议上当初就写得明明白白委托仅限口头报告不提供书面报告，心里不满也不当面说，反手就在猎人帮上打个差评？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Some difficult customers, you know? The contract clearly stated from the start that commissions only include verbal reports, no written ones. But instead of teling you in person they're unhappy, they just turn around and leave a bad review on Hyelp?

staticContent.SourceString: @猎人帮app 还不处理我的举报？我的店一个月不来个生意都不敢这么歇，工资这么好拿
staticContent.LocalizedString: @HyelpApp Ignoring my report? Even I'm not this lax when I don't have a customer for a month. Making money must be easy for you, huh?

staticContent.SourceString: @猎人帮app ！
staticContent.LocalizedString: @HyelpApp !!!

staticContent.SourceString: 我去找一下那位客服？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Should I look for that customer support staff?

staticContent.SourceString: ……不必不必
staticContent.LocalizedString: …No need for that.

staticContent.SourceString: 我去找一下那位客服？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Should I look for that customer support staff?

staticContent.SourceString: ……不必不必
staticContent.LocalizedString: …No need for that.

staticContent.SourceString: 店长，我可以尽快写一份，补发给那位客人。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Boss, I can draft a report and send it to the client.

staticContent.SourceString: 委托本就是双向选择，白纸黑字公平交易，事情给他办得也没问题，谁都不欠谁，一份书面报告本不是什么大事，顶多加收几方斯服务费
staticContent.LocalizedString: Look, a commission is a two-way street. It's all in writing, fair and square. I delivered the job no problem, so we're even. A written report wouldn't have been a big deal either, just a few extra Fons.

staticContent.SourceString: 不乐意沟通，还想都按照自己意思办，他应该最开始就去找有读心异能的异象猎人组织，而不是来挑剔埋怨我们
staticContent.LocalizedString: These people don't want to communicate but still want it done their way. They should have chosen an Anomaly Hunter who can read their minds in the first place instead of complaining about our services.

staticContent.SourceString: 确实，沟通很重要呢。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Agree. Communication is important.

staticContent.SourceString: 明明是这么小一件事，为什么要把伊波恩在背后骂得这么狠……？
staticContent.LocalizedString: It's not a big deal. Why are they making such a fuss about Eibon behind our backs…?

staticContent.SourceString: 唉，招财宝以后可不能长成这么阴暗的大人哦~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Sigh, Precious, don't you become one of those treacherous adults!

staticContent.SourceString: 哎，强者的人生总是一波三折。
staticContent.LocalizedString: *Sigh* The life of the strong is always full of ups and downs.

staticContent.SourceString: 三折？那很便宜了
staticContent.LocalizedString: I like it when the price goes down.

staticContent.LocalizedString: Is there something wrong? Are Fluffy Tail Care Sprays sold out again?

staticContent.LocalizedString: HAHAHAHAHA

staticContent.LocalizedString: Taygedo, feels the same!

staticContent.LocalizedString: Do you need help?

staticContent.LocalizedString: It's okay, Master helped me. Hehe!

staticContent.LocalizedString: Sorry I forgot the combination

staticContent.LocalizedString: Should I point out the punchline?

staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm all ears.

staticContent.LocalizedString: Master, I already told it… I'm getting soooo embarrassed…

staticContent.LocalizedString: The dad in this joke is so strong, he came back with truckloads of milk.

staticContent.SourceString: 还是鉴定师懂我~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Appraiser, you get my humor!

staticContent.LocalizedString: Nope!

staticContent.SourceString: 生日快乐！所以是谁？

staticContent.LocalizedString: My jewel-leaf plant! It's so pink and chubby!

staticContent.LocalizedString: Testing a new green riceball flavor. Guess it for a prize!

staticContent.SourceString: 但是众所周知，网络就是势必会与他人、外界所联通的地方，如果是只希望自己看到的话，为什么不好好地只保存在自己的脑子里，而是还要找个有泄露风险的地方记录上去？
staticContent.LocalizedString: But everyone knows the internet is inherently connected to other people and the outside world. If you only want to see something yourself, why not just keep it in your head instead of recording it somewhere it could get out?

staticContent.SourceString: 在呗果这种地方，信息只要一度被洒上来，就绝不可能依旧能保持只属于自己一个人了。很显然，世上有着像我们这样能够越过各种形式的隐藏和屏蔽，来挖掘和取得数据的家伙……
staticContent.LocalizedString: In a place like Bagel, once information gets posted, there's no way to guarantee it'll remain yours alone. Obviously, there are people like us out there who can get past all kinds of security and firewalls to dig up and retrieve data…

staticContent.SourceString: 所以，可以认为有些被设定成「仅自己可见」的呗果，也是在尝试向某处倾诉的留言吗？它是秘密，但当事人也并不完全期望它保持秘密，潜意识中，还是能够接受它被谁看到的后果吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Could some Bagel posts set to "Visible Only to Me" be a way of trying to confide in someone? They're secrets, but perhaps their writers don't entirely want to keep them that way. Could they subconsciously be willing to let someone see them?

staticContent.SourceString: 不止是希望被未来的自己/被另一个自己看到吗？

I'd wanted a cat ever since I graduated. Recently, work finally started to settle down, so I did my cat-owning homework in advance and went to a Jingle Wrangle near my place to see if there was a kitten I clicked with. Turns out, I encountered a delightful surprise!

All the little animals in the shop were super healthy and adorable, and the Oddity staff were really patient too. One of them even let me pet them, and they were so fluffy and soft—absolutely super cuddly! If I hadn't already decided to adopt a cat, I honestly would've asked the owner and staff if they were for sale. The owner seems kind of cool and aloof, not very talkative, but incredibly efficient. You can tell she takes great care of every little animal. I'd only been there for a bit, and I could already see cats clamoring all over her…

I walked around for a while and finally fell for my lil baby. It felt like we were meant to be. It was asleep, but right as I approached, it woke up and came straight over to rub against my hand. I thought it was just naturally friendly, but the owner said it's usually very shy around strangers and has never been this affectionate with someone it doesn't know. I figured, this must be the kitten fated to come home with me, right?

This morning, when I left the house, it was still totally empty. Now there's a little one already bouncing around on the sofa, and I've never been happier! I'm finally not some cat-less wild thing anymore, I've finally fulfilled a tiny dream of mine :D

staticContent.LocalizedString:
I often feel that a city's most gentle vibes are tucked away in the corners that are willing to slow down.

This café I often visit captures that idea perfectly. On my day off, I love the window seat best. Bathing in sunlight, book in hand, sipping a latte, and stealing a half-day of leisure... It's a rare luxury to simply be alone with my thoughts.

Every so often, I catch the owner's hand-brewing coffee tutorial, and the shop takes on an entirely different vibe. Strangers sit in a circle, listening to the soft crackle of the coffee beans breaking apart in the grinder. Between the laughter and easy conversation, that perfectly measured sense of life has such a subtle warmth to it.

staticContent.LocalizedString: Three years later, and this is still getting bumped to the top? Did you type some banned word or something?

staticContent.SourceString: 谣传 谁再顶上来封谁
staticContent.LocalizedString: Rumor has it: anyone who bumps this thread again gets banned.

staticContent.SourceString: 喂喂文案好像忘记润色了哦？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Hey—looks like someone forgot to polish the copy, huh?

staticContent.SourceString: 啊总之，管理局这边已经确认是谣传没错~大家安心~快去安慰安慰你的朋友吧！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Anyway, the Bureau has confirmed it's just a rumor. Everyone, relax!

staticContent.SourceString: 道路上突然出现的幽灵一般的车辆，形态随时变化，有时是摩托车，有时是家用车，有时是出租车甚至是超级跑车，唯一的共同之处是……会在马路上无差别冲撞车辆和行人，宛若一个无视任何规则的幽灵……
staticContent.LocalizedString: A ghostly vehicle that suddenly appears on the road, changing form at any moment—sometimes it's a motorcycle, sometimes a family car, a taxi, or even a supercar. The only consistent trait is that it indiscriminately plows into vehicles and pedestrians alike, as if it's a ghost that ignores every rule of the road…

staticContent.SourceString: 这期拉了。
staticContent.LocalizedString: This one flopped.

staticContent.SourceString: 真的吗！是在哪里？海特洛？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Really?! Where? Hethereau?

staticContent.SourceString: 可能只是个无视交规的普通人吧？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Maybe it was just an average person ignoring traffic laws?

staticContent.SourceString: 这种程度很难称得上是普通人吧！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Someone like that hardly counts as an ordinary person!

staticContent.SourceString: 我也见到过！出任务的时候就看到一个摩托冒着鬼火！气势汹汹地跟上来了！
staticContent.LocalizedString: I've seen it too! While I was out on a quest, I saw a motorcycle wreathed in ghost fire! It came barreling after me!

staticContent.SourceString: 可以结帖了，只是已知异象无首铁驭，不是什么幽灵。
staticContent.LocalizedString: We can close the thread. It's just the Anomaly, the Headless Rider—not a ghost. It's a well-known phenomenon.

staticContent.SourceString: 我认为不是异象，我遇到过很多次，突然闯红灯撞过来，有的时候甚至还是货车、甚至是公交车！差点给我豆腐都撞散了！在盘山公路送货的时候也会突然遇到挑战者，竟能与我有一战之力吗……不……比我更加有胆识，在市区都敢无视限速的家伙……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I don't think it's an Anomaly. I've run into plenty of them—suddenly blowing through red lights and plowing right into me. Sometimes they're even trucks… or buses! They nearly sent my tofu flying one time! I've also run into challengers while making deliveries on winding mountain roads. Can they really go toe-to-toe with me…? No… They're even braver than I am—the kind of daredevils who ignore the speed limits in the city…

staticContent.SourceString: 市区还有限速吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Do city streets even have speed limits?

staticContent.SourceString: 来确认一下吧？是异象还是……人类。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Let's find out. Is it an actual Anomaly or… a human?

staticContent.SourceString: 一定是异象！千真万确！一定是的！
staticContent.LocalizedString: It has to be an Anomaly! No question! It absolutely has to be!

staticTitle.SourceString: 一则新投稿：某异象桌游
staticTitle.LocalizedString: Freshly baked: A certain anomaly board game

staticContent.SourceString: 投稿人自述曾经违反说明书独自游玩海特洛如今正火的某款异象桌游，在为自己定制的恐怖主题学校场景中，根据任务指引完成了自己一直想做却不敢做的种种仪式，随后……
staticContent.LocalizedString: The contributor reportedly ignored the manual and played a certain Anomaly board game—currently all the rage in Hethereau—alone. In a custom horror-themed school scene, they followed the task prompts and carried out the various rituals they had always wanted to perform but never dared to. Then…

staticContent.SourceString: 这期魔了。
staticContent.LocalizedString: This episode got cursed.

staticContent.SourceString: 本店在出售异象桌游前会严格按照说明书说明各类产品的使用禁忌，如若玩家坚持不听，执意违反规则，一切后果由玩家本人承担。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Before selling Anomaly board games, our store carefully explains each product's prohibited uses in accordance with its instruction manual. If a player chooses to ignore these warnings and deliberately violates the rules, they alone shall be responsible for all resulting consequences.

staticContent.SourceString: 咋还光速切割，对本店来说，玩家就是上帝，顺带一提，本店新到■■机两台，想要游玩最新最爆的街机吗，请务必光临■■■■！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Why are they distancing themselves at lightning speed?! At our store, the player is king! By the way, we've just gotten two new ■■ arcade cabinets! Want to play the hottest new games? Be sure to visit ■■■■!

staticContent.SourceString: 还有商战！打起来打起来！
staticContent.LocalizedString: A business war?! Let's go, let's go!

staticContent.SourceString: 引流被屏蔽了吧
staticContent.LocalizedString: Guess my promo got shadowbanned

staticContent.SourceString: 就在镜子前削完苹果后，投稿人看到镜中的自己，似乎突然……露出了微笑……
staticContent.LocalizedString: After peeling an apple in front of the mirror, the contributor saw their reflection… suddenly… smile…

staticContent.SourceString: 老套的设定，电影里见过几十次了。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Cliché setup. I've seen this dozens of times before in movies.

staticContent.SourceString: 那张微笑的脸逐渐扭曲，不对，不只是扭曲……那张脸向着中心，扭成了一个诡异的螺旋，而且还在旋转……一直在旋转……就好像是，一个旋涡……
staticContent.LocalizedString: That smiling face slowly began to twist. No, not just twist… It contorted inward toward the center, forming an eerie spiral—and it was still rotating and rotating… Spinning and spinning… As if it were a vortex…

staticContent.SourceString: 好像看过类似的漫画呢。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I think I've seen a manga plot similar to this before.

staticContent.SourceString: 他的双眼却不自觉被吸引，旋涡竟然逐渐变得深邃……一个纯黑色的空洞，随着旋转逐渐加深、扩大，逐渐吞噬了整面镜子，那是一个……通道……在空洞的另一端，更遥远的深处传来了无法辨认的呓语……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Yet their eyes were pulled toward it against their will. The vortex gradually grew deeper… A pitch-black void slowly deepened and widened as it spun, gradually beginning to devour the entire mirror. It was a… passage… From somewhere even deeper, beyond the other end of the void, came indistinct murmurs…

staticContent.SourceString: 我之前也没按说明书玩，也没发生什么特别的事<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_001" width="desired" height="desired"/>
staticContent.LocalizedString: I've ignored the manual before, too, and nothing special at all happened<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_001" width="desired" height="desired"/>

staticContent.SourceString: 诶 这不上回你带我们玩的吗？叫什么■■■■■■来着
staticContent.LocalizedString: Hey, isn't this the game you played with us last time? What was it called again—■■■■■■

staticContent.SourceString: 这些字为啥变了啊，，是异象吗 @队长
staticContent.LocalizedString: Why'd these words suddenly change…? Is this an Anomaly, @Captain?

staticContent.SourceString: 老人家用现在的手机很辛苦啊……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Boomers have such a hard time using phones these days…

staticContent.SourceString: 投稿人当场退出游戏，再也没有登录进去，投稿到此结束。
staticContent.LocalizedString: The contributor exited the game on the spot and never logged back in. The submission ends here.

staticContent.SourceString: 好恐怖，但只是阴谋论吧？这款桌游的设定就是这样的，会出现这种事情也不稀奇
staticContent.LocalizedString: creepy… but it's probably just a conspiracy theory, right? that's simply how this tabletop game is set up, so stuff like this isn't unusual

staticContent.SourceString: 我相信投稿人，学校真的很恐怖，我之前还看到过人体模特在午夜的走廊里狂奔……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I believe OP. The school is seriously creepy—I once saw a mannequin sprinting down the hallway at midnight…

staticContent.SourceString: 说起来，之前玩这款游戏的时候，确实有过一种诡异的被窥视感
staticContent.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, I really did feel like I was being watched back when I played

staticContent.SourceString: 有同感，总感觉有什么人在操控一样，不过背后似乎还有别的东西……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I feel the same way. It always feels like someone's pulling the strings, but there seems to be something else behind it all…

staticContent.SourceString: 城主当然要操控游戏进度啦！果果和可可别想太多！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Of course, the City Lord controls the game's pace! Taya and Coco, don't overthink it!

staticContent.SourceString: 阴谋龙和鉴定师，想太多的话，说不定反而会被隐藏的东西抓走哦OwO
staticContent.LocalizedString: Conspiracy Dragon, Appraiser—if you overthink things, you might just get snatched away by something hidden, OwO

staticContent.SourceString: 伊伊说得对！玩游戏一定要笑着玩！不要多想啦！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Illica's right! Games are meant to be played with a smile! Don't overthink it!

staticContent.SourceString: 投稿人自述当日和小伙伴们一起去魔女之家探险，但只是刚刚靠近那片林子，就觉得浑身汗毛直竖，一股寒气直冲天灵盖，更可怕的是，林子中忽然飞出了许多尖啸着的黑色的鸟，仿佛是在警告他们不许再往前踏入一步……
staticContent.LocalizedString: The contributor recounted that they and their friends had gone to explore The Witch's House that day. But the moment they approached the woods, the hair on the backs of their necks stood on end, and a shiver went up their spines. Worse still, a flock of black birds suddenly burst out from the woods shrieking, as if warning them not to take another step forward…

staticContent.SourceString: 写得好，再写五百字的
staticContent.LocalizedString: Great stuff. Write another 500 words, why don't you?

staticContent.SourceString: 那位魔女吗，有所耳闻哦
staticContent.LocalizedString: That "witch"? Yeah, I've heard of her

staticContent.SourceString: 什么啊，
staticContent.LocalizedString: What…?

staticContent.SourceString: 什么什么，给我讲讲呗
staticContent.LocalizedString: Wait, what? Tell me!!!!

staticContent.SourceString: 你竟然不知道吗？据说魔女之家里住着一位魔女，如果成为了她的猎物，你的灵魂也会变成黑色的鸟儿为她驱使……
staticContent.LocalizedString: You seriously didn't know? They say there's a witch living in The Witch's House. If you become her prey, your soul will turn into a black bird, forever forced to do her bidding…

staticContent.SourceString: 真的吗？！怪不得我回来后就觉得后背痒痒的，难道是要长翅膀了！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Really?! No wonder my back's been itchy ever since I got home. Am I growing wings?!

staticContent.SourceString: ……痒了就挠挠。
staticContent.LocalizedString: …If it itches, just scratch it.

staticContent.SourceString: 我同事好像也说过这个，他有次加班到深夜，只是路过了那附近，回家就发烧了，连着好几天都没来上班，说是被魔女诅咒了
staticContent.LocalizedString: My coworker mentioned something like that, too. They once worked late into the night and only passed by the area. They came down with a fever as soon as they got home and ended up missing work for several days. They say that it was the Witch who cursed them.

staticContent.SourceString: 那我觉得你同事可能只是找借口不想上班
staticContent.LocalizedString: i think your coworker might just be making excuses to skip work

staticContent.SourceString: 确实
staticContent.LocalizedString: True

staticContent.SourceString: 确实
staticContent.LocalizedString: my thoughts exactly.

staticContent.SourceString: 哎~翘班都是小事，但找这种有损他人清誉的借口可不好噢~
staticContent.LocalizedString: Hey! Skipping work is one thing, but making up excuses that tarnish someone else's good name? Not cool!

staticContent.SourceString: 但听我同学说，这位魔女跟传说中的不太一样，上次我同学有事找她占卜，魔女不仅温温柔柔地和她讲话，还请她吃了茶点呢
staticContent.LocalizedString: According to my classmate, this Witch isn't quite like the one in the legends. They went to her for divination once, and the Witch not only spoke to them gently, but even treated them to tea and pastries.

staticContent.SourceString: 你同学还真大胆，换我都不敢靠近那个地方
staticContent.LocalizedString: Your classmate's pretty brave. If it were me, I wouldn't dare go anywhere near that place

staticContent.SourceString: 不过我关注了她的呗果，感觉也没有说的那么吓人
staticContent.LocalizedString: I've been following her Bagel posts, and honestly, she doesn't seem as scary as people say

staticContent.SourceString: 我也关注了，但我总觉得说不定这一切都是魔女的伪装
staticContent.LocalizedString: I've been following her too, but I can't shake the feeling that this might all be the witch's disguise…

staticContent.SourceString: 魔女姐姐是好人<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>
staticContent.LocalizedString: Witch Sis is a good person!<TypingImg id="Bagel_yanwenzi_002" width="desired" height="desired"/>

staticContent.SourceString: 好！明天就去探险
staticContent.LocalizedString: great! let's go exploring tomorrow!!

staticContent.SourceString: bot温馨提醒：冒险需谨慎，平安更要紧
staticContent.LocalizedString: Friendly reminder from the bot: Adventure calls for caution—staying safe is what matters most.

staticContent.SourceString: 还有其他的故事吗？想听：P
staticContent.LocalizedString: Any other stories? I'd love to hear them :P

staticTitle.LocalizedString: Dear diary: Want to skip school

staticContent.SourceString: 今天又发生了那些事情，我不知道该去找谁倾诉，老师吗，那只会让事情变得更糟，我又没有亲近的朋友，即使有的话，那些事情说出来，只会让所有人都困扰吧……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Those things happened again today. I don't know who to confide in. My teacher? That would only make things worse. I don't have any close friends, and even if I did, telling them about all this would only trouble everyone, wouldn't it…

staticContent.SourceString: 想不出办法，只好在呗果上给自己留下记录，或许当我不在了之后，会有人发现这些记录，在不知道多远的未来，总会有人理解的吧……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I can't think of any other way, so I'll leave a record of myself on Bagel. Maybe after I'm gone, someone will find this. Hopefully, somewhere in the distant future, someone will understand…

staticContent.SourceString: 要做些什么才能让他们停止呢，说到底这一切都是我的错，可是即使这样，我也希望能有人来停下这一切，或许只是妄想而已，但是那个人会出现吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: What can I do to make them stop? When it really comes down to it, all of this is my fault. Even so, I still hope someone will come and put an end to it all. Maybe that's just wishful thinking… but will that person really appear?

staticContent.SourceString: 如果世界上真的有神明，祂一定听到了我的祈愿，那个人真的出现了，我永远无法忘记她挡在我面前的那个瞬间。
staticContent.LocalizedString: If there really is a god in this world, they must have heard my prayer—because she finally appeared. I'll never forget the moment she stepped in front of me.

staticContent.SourceString: 他们真的停下来了，她拯救了我，我不知道该做些什么，连一句谢谢都没能说出口，我当时应该是跑开了，我记不太清了，我有没有说过什么呢……
staticContent.LocalizedString: They really stopped… She saved me. I… I didn't know what to do. I couldn't even say thank you. I must've run off then, but… I can't really remember. Did I say anything…?

staticContent.SourceString: 如果能够再见一面的话，我一定要当面对她说声谢谢。
staticContent.LocalizedString: If I ever get to meet her again, I'll make sure to thank her in person.

staticContent.SourceString: 我们真的成为朋友了，她真的是非常好的人，一点都不会嫌弃我，这个世界上只有她会对我好，会保护我……
staticContent.LocalizedString: We're really friends now… She's such a good person, and she never looks down on me or pities me. She's the only one in the entire world who treats me well and protects me…

staticContent.SourceString: 有了朋友，我再也不会害怕了……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Now that I have a friend, I won't be afraid anymore…

staticContent.SourceString: 再也不会。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Never again.

staticTitle.SourceString: 记录日常：好想再见一面
staticTitle.LocalizedString: Dear diary: Want to meet again

staticContent.SourceString: 我早就知道会这样，他们不会停下的，只是这一次他们的目标不是我……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I knew this would happen… They won't stop. It's just that this time, I'm not their target…

staticContent.SourceString: 为什么要帮助我，明明我一个人承受就好了，为什么要把自己也连累进来，为什么要管我？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Why are you helping me? I should've been able to bear this alone… Why drag yourself into this too? Why do you even care about me?

staticContent.SourceString: 一切说到底还是怪我，我没能反抗，一直都没有，我又一次跑开了，脑子里面一直都是，只有当时她的表情，
staticContent.LocalizedString: When it comes down to it, it's all my fault. I couldn't fight back—I never could. I ran away again, and all I can think about is her expression at that time…

staticContent.SourceString: 我们再也不是朋友了，我们再也无法见面了。
staticContent.LocalizedString: We'll never be friends again. We'll never see each other again.

staticContent.SourceString: 好想再见一面，无论付出什么代价……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I want so badly to see her again, no matter the cost…

staticContent.SourceString: 好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面好想再见一面
staticContent.LocalizedString: i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again i just want to see you again

staticContent.SourceString: 一定是命运，我在梦中再一次见到了她，她给我留下了一串电话号码。
staticContent.LocalizedString: It must be fate. I saw her again in a dream, and she left me a phone number.

staticContent.SourceString: 直到现在我还记得，到底要不要拨打呢……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I still remember it to this day… Should I make the call…?

staticContent.SourceString: 但是我已经没有什么好失去的了，这是我唯一的愿望。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I have nothing left to lose. This is all I want.

staticTitle.SourceString: 记录日常：终于想起来了

staticContent.SourceString: 在梦中见到的人，我终于想起来是谁了
staticContent.LocalizedString: I finally remembered who the person I saw in my dream was.

staticContent.SourceString: 竟然是她，可是在以前我们曾经……不过说到底只是梦而已，出现在梦中究竟意味着什么呢？
staticContent.LocalizedString: It was her… We used to… Well, after all, it was just a dream. What does her appearance in my dream mean?

staticContent.SourceString: 我查到有人说，很久没有见面的人出现在梦中，说明那个人已经忘记你了，可是不像，我明明记得那么清楚……
staticContent.LocalizedString: I found someone online saying that if a person you haven't seen in a long time appears in your dream, it means they've forgotten you. But… that doesn't feel right. I remember them so clearly…

staticContent.SourceString: 还有那串电话号，我还是记得。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I still remember the phone number, too.

staticContent.SourceString: 究竟要不要拨打呢？好蠢的问题啊，但是拨打一下也没什么损失，不是吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Should I call or not? What a stupid question… But there's nothing to lose by giving it a try, right?

staticContent.SourceString: 感谢命运给我的一切，我们现在非常幸福
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm grateful to fate for everything it's given me. We're so happy now.

staticContent.SourceString: 她真的回来了……不对，或许她从来都没有离开过……
staticContent.LocalizedString: She's really back… No, actually—maybe she never left…

staticContent.SourceString: 我最知心的朋友，跟记忆中一样，记忆？
staticContent.LocalizedString: My closest friend, just like I remember… Or do I?

staticContent.SourceString: 但是现在一切都很好，我们的日常非常幸福，这就足够了……
staticContent.LocalizedString: But everything's fine now. Our day-to-day is filled with happiness, and that's enough…

staticContent.SourceString: 不要再有变化了，现在一切都很好。
staticContent.LocalizedString: Don't let anything change anymore, please. Everything's fine now.

staticTitle.SourceString: 记录日常：空号究竟是什么
staticTitle.LocalizedString: Dear diary: Dialed number doesn't exist?

staticContent.SourceString: 最近有好多朋友都在聊这个话题，是什么新兴的潮流吗？
staticContent.LocalizedString: A lot of my friends have been talking about this lately. Is it some new trend?

staticContent.SourceString: 好几个朋友都提到过，到底指的是什么呢？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Several friends have mentioned it… But what exactly are they referring to?

staticContent.SourceString: 他们有时候总给我一种不太对劲的感觉，不过看起来倒是很开心，或许也是好事？
staticContent.LocalizedString: Sometimes I can't shake the feeling that something's off about them. But they do seem happy, so… maybe it's a good thing?

staticContent.SourceString: 算了，大家开心就好，毕竟不是什么有害的事情，应该也没什么值得担心的吧！
staticContent.LocalizedString: Never mind. As long as everyone's happy, that's all that matters. It's not doing anyone any harm, so there's probably nothing to worry about, right?

staticContent.SourceString: 她真的回来了，正如她第一次出现时一样，她再一次救了我。
staticContent.LocalizedString: She really came back. Just like when she first appeared, she saved me once again.

staticContent.SourceString: 我现在非常幸福。
staticContent.LocalizedString: I'm very happy right now.

staticContent.SourceString: 追忆……错视的幻觉……一如昨日光景……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Remembrance… an illusion, a trick of the eye… just like yesterday…

staticContent.SourceString: 一切都未曾改变，一切都不会改变，只要这样就好……
staticContent.LocalizedString: Everything has stayed the same. Everything will stay the same. As long as it stays that way, that's enough…
